NewsArticle.Title: Fair Coordinators Wanted
NewsArticle.Content: Cedric, Mundane Burgess of Mileth, writes: The first Mileth Fair was great fun for Aislings and mundanes. We look forward to the next one. Fair Coordinator sought. Aisling must: - Have event organizing skills - Have Temuairan political skills The Fair Coordinators will be responsible for staffing and organizing the fair events. Send your Fair events plan ((candle@darkages.com Subject:DarkAges_Event_Fair)) and list of Aislings who have agreed to staff the fair as guards and official seal bearers. Fair will last for a weekend. Read previous news about the Fair to better understand it. Speak with previous Fair Coordinators for details and their experience. Cedric Burgess of Mileth
